MapBop — Privacy policy

Last updated: October 18, 2026

On this page

Accounts and device permissions

MapBop (WhereIsIt) does not require a game account. Playing does not require a name, email address, precise location, contacts, or photo access. Player names entered for a race stay on your device.

Local game data

Progress, preferences, and race history are stored on your device. Removing the app’s local data deletes these records. Operating-system backups may be managed separately.

Analytics — PostHog

In builds with analytics configured, gameplay events, a random installation identifier, platform, and gameplay properties are sent to PostHog’s EU infrastructure. Although this ID does not directly identify you by name, it is an installation-linked identifier. Remote analytics is disabled in builds without a configured key.

Advertising — Google AdMob

In ad-enabled builds, Google AdMob may process advertising identifiers and device and ad-interaction data to serve and measure ads. A consent flow is presented where required. You can change available preferences in the ad privacy section of game settings. Google advertising policy ↗.

Purchases — RevenueCat and stores

In purchase-enabled builds, payments are processed by the App Store or Google Play. RevenueCat may process an installation identifier and transaction or receipt information to verify entitlements. Oyri Games does not receive full card details.

Retention and deletion

Local saves remain on your device until removed. Retention of server-side analytics and transaction records depends on the active providers’ configuration; a verified fixed duration has not yet been published. See the data deletion page below for installation-related requests.

Children

MapBop is a general-audience game and is not specifically directed at children under 13.

Requests and contact
